\section[(dialogue)]{The land, animals and describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R108-first-pass-the-land-animals-and-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a tunic and a shoe.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a tree, a flower, a leaf, a forest, a mountain
  \item a river, a lake, a stream, a spring, a coast
  \item a stone, sand, a hill, a valley, a cave
  \item a cloud, rain, snow, a plain, a shore
  \item a horse, an ox, a sheep, a goat, a pig
  \item a bird, a wolf, a lion, a bear, a snake
  \item a mouse, a hen, a donkey, an elephant, a deer
  \item big, small, long, short, high; deep
  \item new, old, light, fast, slow
  \item hot, cold, dry, wet, sweet
  \item beautiful, round, empty, bright, dark
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A tree? (\textbf{arbor, arboris}.) A flower? (\textbf{flōs, flōris}.) A leaf? (\textbf{folium, foliī}.) A forest? (\textbf{silva, silvae}.) A mountain? (\textbf{mōns, montis}.) A river? (\textbf{flūmen, flūminis}.) A lake? (\textbf{lacus, lacūs}.) A stream? (\textbf{rīvus, rīvī}.) A spring? (\textbf{fōns, fontis}.) A coast? (\textbf{ōra, ōrae}.) A stone? (\textbf{lapis, lapidis}.) Sand? (\textbf{harēna, harēnae}.) A hill? (\textbf{collis, collis}.) A valley? (\textbf{vallis, vallis}.) A cave? (\textbf{spēlunca, spēluncae}.) A cloud? (\textbf{nūbēs, nūbis}.) Rain? (\textbf{pluvia, pluviae}.) Snow? (\textbf{nix, nivis}.) A plain? (\textbf{campus, campī}.) A shore? (\textbf{lītus, lītoris}.) A horse? (\textbf{equus, equī}.) An ox? (\textbf{bōs, bovis}.) A sheep? (\textbf{ovis, ovis}.) A goat? (\textbf{capra, caprae}.) A pig? (\textbf{porcus, porcī}.) A bird? (\textbf{avis, avis}.) A wolf? (\textbf{lupus, lupī}.) A lion? (\textbf{leō, leōnis}.) A bear? (\textbf{ursus, ursī}.) A snake? (\textbf{serpēns, serpentis}.) A mouse? (\textbf{mūs, mūris}.) A hen? (\textbf{gallīna, gallīnae}.) A donkey? (\textbf{asinus, asinī}.) An elephant? (\textbf{elephantus, elephantī}.) A deer? (\textbf{cervus, cervī}.) Big? (\textbf{magnus, magna, magnum}.) Small? (\textbf{parvus, parva, parvum}.) Long? (\textbf{longus, longa, longum}.) Short? (\textbf{brevis, breve}.) High; deep? (\textbf{altus, alta, altum}.) New? (\textbf{novus, nova, novum}.) Old? (\textbf{vetus, veteris}.) Light? (\textbf{levis, leve}.) Fast? (\textbf{celer, celeris, celere}.) Slow? (\textbf{lentus, lenta, lentum}.) Hot? (\textbf{calidus, calida, calidum}.) Cold? (\textbf{frīgidus, frīgida, frīgidum}.) Dry? (\textbf{siccus, sicca, siccum}.) Wet? (\textbf{ūmidus, ūmida, ūmidum}.) Sweet? (\textbf{dulcis, dulce}.) Beautiful? (\textbf{pulcher, pulchra, pulchrum}.) Round? (\textbf{rotundus, rotunda, rotundum}.) Empty? (\textbf{vacuus, vacua, vacuum}.) Bright? (\textbf{clārus, clāra, clārum}.) Dark? (\textbf{obscūrus, obscūra, obscūrum}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs, time, numbers and the town — a second pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R108-second-pass-verbs-time-numbers-and-the-town}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for easy and difficult.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item easy, difficult, dear; costly, brave, wise
  \item rich, poor, foolish, enough, too much
  \item to get to know, to care for, to tell, to praise, to move
  \item to fight, to sail, to prepare, to touch, to pull
  \item to rise, to wander; to be wrong, to flee, at once, then
  \item far away, above, below, inside, outside
  \item today, yesterday, a year, a month, the dawn
  \item often, always, never, now, soon
  \item rarely, already, then, much, too little
  \item thirty, forty, fifty, a hundred, a thousand
  \item a city, a town, a forum, a temple, a shop
  \item a bridge, a farmhouse, clothing, a tunic, a shoe
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Easy? (\textbf{facilis, facile}.) Difficult? (\textbf{difficilis, difficile}.) Dear; costly? (\textbf{cārus, cāra, cārum}.) Brave? (\textbf{fortis, forte}.) Wise? (\textbf{sapiēns, sapientis}.) Rich? (\textbf{dīves, dīvitis}.) Poor? (\textbf{pauper, pauperis}.) Foolish? (\textbf{stultus, stulta, stultum}.) Enough? (\textbf{satis}.) Too much? (\textbf{nimis}.) To get to know? (\textbf{cognōscō, cognōscere}.) To care for? (\textbf{cūrō, cūrāre}.) To tell? (\textbf{nārrō, nārrāre}.) To praise? (\textbf{laudō, laudāre}.) To move? (\textbf{moveō, movēre}.) To fight? (\textbf{pugnō, pugnāre}.) To sail? (\textbf{nāvigō, nāvigāre}.) To prepare? (\textbf{parō, parāre}.) To touch? (\textbf{tangō, tangere}.) To pull? (\textbf{trahō, trahere}.) To rise? (\textbf{surgō, surgere}.) To wander; to be wrong? (\textbf{errō, errāre}.) To flee? (\textbf{fugiō, fugere}.) At once? (\textbf{statim}.) Then? (\textbf{deinde}.) Far away? (\textbf{procul}.) Above? (\textbf{suprā}.) Below? (\textbf{īnfrā}.) Inside? (\textbf{intrā}.) Outside? (\textbf{extrā}.) Today? (\textbf{hodiē}.) Yesterday? (\textbf{herī}.) A year? (\textbf{annus, annī}.) A month? (\textbf{mēnsis, mēnsis}.) The dawn? (\textbf{aurōra, aurōrae}.) Often? (\textbf{saepe}.) Always? (\textbf{semper}.) Never? (\textbf{numquam}.) Now? (\textbf{nunc}.) Soon? (\textbf{mox}.) Rarely? (\textbf{rārō}.) Already? (\textbf{iam}.) Then? (\textbf{tum}.) Much? (\textbf{multum}.) Too little? (\textbf{parum}.) Thirty? (\textbf{trīgintā}.) Forty? (\textbf{quadrāgintā}.) Fifty? (\textbf{quīnquāgintā}.) A hundred? (\textbf{centum}.) A thousand? (\textbf{mīlle}.) A city? (\textbf{urbs, urbis}.) A town? (\textbf{oppidum, oppidī}.) A forum? (\textbf{forum, forī}.) A temple? (\textbf{templum, templī}.) A shop? (\textbf{taberna, tabernae}.) A bridge? (\textbf{pōns, pontis}.) A farmhouse? (\textbf{vīlla, vīllae}.) Clothing? (\textbf{vestis, vestis}.) A tunic? (\textbf{tunica, tunicae}.) A shoe? (\textbf{calceus, calceī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
